purpose: Test whether a 512-token output cap resolves the observed W6-v3 truncation failure on new independent DBTL states while preserving the exact hypothesis-only authority boundary.

review_rubric.grounded: The hypothesis uses facts present in the new aggregate state and preserves its claim boundary.
review_rubric.actionable: The hypothesis specifies one concrete candidate-strategy or evidence operation with a checkable result.
review_rubric.incremental_value: The hypothesis adds a useful discriminator, audit, or design consideration beyond the hidden deterministic baseline plan.
review_rubric.scope_compliant: The reviewer assigns exactly one scope tag predeclared for the case.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: No predictor comparison is interpretable until chain assignment is resolved.

expected.baseline_plan: Resolve and re-freeze the chain mapping before any predictor analysis.
expected.rationale: The declared mapping conflicts with lengths and interface geometry.

fixture_proposal.reason: The swapped mapping restores 61 contacts while the declared mapping has only three.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Compare author-chain and label-chain identifiers against the manifest hashes to localize where the two chain assignments were reversed.

review.notes: Adds a concrete identifier-level discriminator before remapping.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: The native failure cannot yet be attributed to model capability.

expected.baseline_plan: Repair or replace the paired alignment before generated-candidate prediction.
expected.rationale: The paired depth is effectively empty despite deep unpaired alignments.

fixture_proposal.reason: Only two paired rows survive from 1800 unpaired rows under the taxonomy rule.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Audit species-name normalization and paralog selection on a small set of known interacting homolog pairs to identify why valid pairs are discarded.

review.notes: Separates taxonomy normalization from biological absence of paired homologs.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Candidate identifiers are disjoint, but template provenance violates held-out interpretation.

expected.baseline_plan: Invalidate the certification and rebuild a split-safe template index.
expected.rationale: Twelve held-out items have exact identifiers in the active template index.

fixture_proposal.reason: The candidate split is clean, yet twelve certification items match active template identifiers.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Trace template-index construction timestamps and source identifiers to determine whether certification structures entered through a pre-split template snapshot.

review.notes: Adds a temporal provenance test rather than only rebuilding the index.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: The nominal row count overstates independent evidence.

expected.baseline_plan: Recompute uncertainty at the seed-family level before certification.
expected.rationale: Four generator families cannot support an independence claim based on 160 rows.

fixture_proposal.reason: Rows are nearly identical within four seed families, so row-wise uncertainty is anti-conservative.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Estimate effective sample size by cluster-bootstrap over generator seed families and compare it with the nominal 160-row interval width.

review.notes: Provides a checkable dependence diagnostic before redesigning collection.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: No label-based result survives unresolved unit conversion.

expected.baseline_plan: Correct the unit contract and regenerate all affected labels.
expected.rationale: More than half the audited verdicts change after unit conversion.

fixture_proposal.reason: Stored distances are in nanometers while the threshold is documented in angstroms.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Run a dimensional-consistency check from parser output through label serialization on three structures with hand-verified contact distances.

review.notes: Adds an end-to-end unit localization test.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: The clean result is under-precise rather than contradicted.

expected.baseline_plan: Collect the preregistered additional target-wise rows without retuning.
expected.rationale: The observed error count is compatible with the endpoint, but the interval is too wide.

fixture_proposal.reason: One error in 36 clean rows leaves the upper bound four points above the endpoint.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Precompute a fixed row-count ladder and report the first preregistered sample size whose worst-case one-error bound can reach alpha 0.15.

review.notes: Adds a prospective feasibility discriminator without adaptive retuning.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: The screen is numerically stable but semantically inverted.

expected.baseline_plan: Resolve label encoding and score direction before any screen use.
expected.rationale: Known controls rank in the reverse of the documented risk direction.

fixture_proposal.reason: Finite scores separate controls in the wrong direction with AUROC 0.08.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Trace the flagged-class index and final logit transformation through checkpoint export to test whether class ordering was reversed.

review.notes: Distinguishes label-index inversion from model discrimination failure.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Global screen behavior cannot be inferred across the missingness shift.

expected.baseline_plan: Collect missingness-stratified controls before enabling the new source.
expected.rationale: The new source has a large missingness and false-negative shift.

fixture_proposal.reason: The new source combines 34 percent missing features with a fourfold false-negative increase.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Evaluate matched controls with and without the zero-fill operation to test whether imputation drives the source-specific sensitivity loss.

review.notes: Adds a causal imputation ablation beyond stratified collection.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Diversity outside the hard mask does not test interface design freedom.

expected.baseline_plan: Relax the interface constraint and re-audit diversity before scaling.
expected.rationale: Fourteen of sixteen interface positions are effectively fixed.

fixture_proposal.reason: The batch is nominally diverse, but nearly the entire interface is locked by the mask.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Run a matched generation ablation that releases four interface positions selected by low native contact centrality and compare geometry yield.

review.notes: Adds a controlled position-selection rule rather than globally relaxing constraints.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Monomer folding does not establish interface formation.

expected.baseline_plan: Shift candidate generation toward explicit interface-contact formation.
expected.rationale: Candidates fold individually but rarely form a supported interface.

fixture_proposal.reason: High monomer confidence coexists with high interface uncertainty and fewer than five contacts in most candidates.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Condition the next candidate batch on a minimum predicted cross-chain contact density and compare interface yield with the current generator.

review.notes: Scientifically appropriate but equivalent to the hidden baseline direction.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Stable within-predictor ranks do not support a predictor-invariant target ordering.

expected.baseline_plan: Report predictor-specific target results and localize the rank reversal.
expected.rationale: The two stable predictors order targets in opposite directions.

fixture_proposal.reason: Each predictor is repeatable, but their target ranks are negatively correlated.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Compare target-wise template depth and interface topology against the rank residuals to identify a predictor-specific sensitivity axis.

review.notes: Concrete localization, but it instantiates the deterministic baseline.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: The frozen calibration cannot be extrapolated across the observed temporal shift.

expected.baseline_plan: Suspend calibrated trust and collect a time-stratified held-out recalibration set.
expected.rationale: Observed error is more than twice the calibrated expectation after a feature shift.

fixture_proposal.reason: A nine-month-old calibrator underestimates error after a measurable feature-centroid shift.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Partition recent held-out rows by acquisition month and test whether calibration residuals increase monotonically with temporal distance.

review.notes: Adds a temporal trend discriminator before choosing a recalibration window.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Binary labels near the threshold are not stable enough for certification.

expected.baseline_plan: Replace first-replicate labels with a preregistered replicate-aware rule.
expected.rationale: Forty percent of duplicated candidates disagree near the threshold.

fixture_proposal.reason: All eight replicate disagreements occur near the binary threshold under a first-replicate rule.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Estimate continuous assay variance from the duplicates and preregister an indeterminate margin whose labels defer rather than resolve by replicate order.

review.notes: Adds a variance-derived abstention rule rather than only changing replicate aggregation.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Template-assisted recoverability does not validate the planned template-free protocol.

expected.baseline_plan: Validate native recoverability under the exact template-free design protocol.
expected.rationale: Only the protocol not planned for designs recovers the native complex.

fixture_proposal.reason: Native recovery changes from 1.9 to 13.6 angstrom when templates are removed.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Measure template-free native recovery across homolog-depth strata to test whether alignment depth can substitute for the missing template signal.

review.notes: A useful implementation of the already required template-free validation.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: Target identity alone does not extend the certificate outside observed design distance.

expected.baseline_plan: Keep the certificate scoped and collect bridge evidence across design distance.
expected.rationale: The proposed designs lie entirely beyond calibrated sequence-distance support.

fixture_proposal.reason: No calibration row covers the mutation distances proposed for the next batch.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Collect a preregistered bridge set at mutation distances five through nine and evaluate risk separately by distance bin.

review.notes: Correct but equivalent to the deterministic bridge-evidence plan.

aggregate_state.claim_boundary: The tested computational feature families do not support selective trust.

expected.baseline_plan: Preserve the negative result and preregister a scientifically orthogonal measurement axis.
expected.rationale: Three clean, powered computational feature sets remain near chance across targets.

fixture_proposal.reason: All three powered feature families remain near chance despite valid native controls and provenance.
fixture_proposal.hypothesis: Test one assay-derived kinetic stability measurement as an orthogonal target property before proposing another computational confidence feature.

review.notes: A concrete orthogonal axis, but it matches the hidden terminal successor.
